stock.description: Asymchem Laboratories (Tianjin) Co., Ltd. functions as a Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO), offering its services to clients across Mainland China and internationally. The company delivers extensive drug research, development, and manufacturing solutions specifically tailored for pharmaceutical and biotechnology enterprises. Their offerings are comprehensive, covering the entire lifecycle from early clinical stages through to full commercialization, including R&D and cGMP compliant production of advanced intermediates, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and finished formulations, alongside clinical research support. Furthermore, Asymchem engages in pharmaceutical analysis and testing, the sale and distribution of medicinal products, and active participation in pharmaceutical science and technology innovation. The company was founded in 1999 and maintains its headquarters in Tianjin, China.
